title: Battle of White Mountain
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of White Mountain", at revision 1376079217, opens: "The Battle of White Mountain was fought on 8 November 1620 outside Prague in the early stages of the Thirty Years' War. An army backing Frederick V led by Christian of Anhalt was defeated by forces supporting his rival Ferdinand II, Holy Roman Emperor, under Bucquoy and Count Tilly." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4373, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle ending Bohemian phase of Thirty Years' War (1620)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
